```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

for candidate in (Path("."), Path("reports")):
    if (candidate / "mlflow_guidellm.py").exists():
        sys.path.insert(0, str(candidate.resolve()))
        break
from mlflow_guidellm import load_guidellm_run

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")

RUN_COLORS = {
    "Humming (vLLM-bench, Aug 3)": "#9467bd",
    "Humming (GuideLLM / MLflow, Aug 24)": "#17becf",
}

DIR_ARCHIVED = ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000"
MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID = "372"
MLFLOW_RUN_ID = "6b4f197ebba84c83938e56b6bd4fc899"


def load_vllm_bench(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    paths = [
        p
        for p in data_dir.glob("conc-*.json")
        if p.stem.split("-")[1].isdigit() and "topup" not in p.name
    ]
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        rows.append(
            {
                "run": label,
                "concurrency": int(d["max_concurrency"]),
                "num_prompts": d["num_prompts"],
                "duration_s": d["duration"],
                "completed": d["completed"],
                "failed": d["failed"],
                "incomplete": 0,
                "request_throughput": d["request_throughput"],
                "output_throughput": d["output_throughput"],
                "mean_ttft_ms": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
                "p90_ttft_ms": d["p90_ttft_ms"],
                "p99_ttft_ms": d["p99_ttft_ms"],
                "mean_tpot_ms": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
                "mean_itl_ms": d.get("mean_itl_ms", d["mean_tpot_ms"]),
                "mean_e2el_ms": d["mean_e2el_ms"],
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("concurrency").reset_index(drop=True)


def read_seed(data_dir: Path) -> str:
    p = data_dir / "seed.txt"
    return p.read_text().strip() if p.exists() else "n/a"


LABEL_OLD = "Humming (vLLM-bench, Aug 3)"
LABEL_NEW = "Humming (GuideLLM / MLflow, Aug 24)"

df_old = load_vllm_bench(DIR_ARCHIVED, LABEL_OLD)
df_new, _mlflow_payload, MLFLOW_URL = load_guidellm_run(
    MLFLOW_RUN_ID,
    experiment_id=MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID,
    label=LABEL_NEW,
)
both = pd.concat([df_old, df_new], ignore_index=True)

SEED_OLD = read_seed(DIR_ARCHIVED)

merged = df_old.merge(df_new, on="concurrency", suffixes=("_old", "_new"))
for col in ("output_throughput", "mean_ttft_ms", "mean_itl_ms", "mean_e2el_ms"):
    merged[f"ratio_{col}"] = merged[f"{col}_new"] / merged[f"{col}_old"]
    merged[f"pct_{col}"] = (merged[f"ratio_{col}"] - 1.0) * 100

peak_old = df_old.loc[df_old["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
peak_new = df_new.loc[df_new["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
base_old = df_old.loc[df_old["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
base_new = df_new.loc[df_new["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]


def per_config_table(df, extra=None):
    cols = [
        "concurrency",
        "num_prompts",
        "duration_s",
        "completed",
        "incomplete",
        "request_throughput",
        "output_throughput",
        "mean_ttft_ms",
        "mean_itl_ms",
        "mean_e2el_ms",
    ]
    show = df[cols].copy()
    show["concurrency"] = show["concurrency"].astype(int)
    show["num_prompts"] = show["num_prompts"].astype(int)
    show["completed"] = show["completed"].astype(int)
    show["incomplete"] = show["incomplete"].astype(int)
    show["duration_s"] = show["duration_s"].round(1)
    show["request_throughput"] = show["request_throughput"].round(2)
    show["output_throughput"] = show["output_throughput"].round(1)
    show["mean_ttft_ms"] = show["mean_ttft_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_itl_ms"] = show["mean_itl_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_e2el_ms"] = (show["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000).round(1)
    show = show.rename(
        columns={
            "concurrency": "C",
            "num_prompts": "completed reqs",
            "duration_s": "dur (s)",
            "completed": "ok",
            "incomplete": "in-flight",
            "request_throughput": "req/s",
            "output_throughput": "out tok/s",
            "mean_ttft_ms": "TTFT (ms)",
            "mean_itl_ms": "ITL (ms)",
            "mean_e2el_ms": "E2E (s)",
        }
    )
    return show.style.hide(axis="index").format(
        {
            "C": "{:d}",
            "completed reqs": "{:d}",
            "dur (s)": "{:.1f}",
            "ok": "{:d}",
            "in-flight": "{:d}",
            "req/s": "{:.2f}",
            "out tok/s": "{:.1f}",
            "TTFT (ms)": "{:.1f}",
            "ITL (ms)": "{:.1f}",
            "E2E (s)": "{:.1f}",
        }
    )
```

# Goal

Check whether the **BenchFlow / MLflow Humming 1k/1k** run reproduces the Humming curve from the published [PP2 Marlin vs Humming](https://mnmehta.github.io/kimi-k3/pp2-marlin-vs-humming-1000-1000.html) report.

Same intended recipe: **TP8×PP2**, `--moe-backend humming`, MXFP4 Kimi-K3, **1000/1000**, C ∈ {1…512}. The serving stack matches (`vllm/vllm-openai:kimi-k3`, SiTU allowlist). The **client harness does not**: archived data is `vllm bench serve`; MLflow data is GuideLLM.

# Configuration

| | **Archived Humming** | **BenchFlow / MLflow Humming** |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Date | August 3, 2026 | August 24, 2026 |
| Recipe | `pp2-humming` | BenchFlow `rhaiis-kimi-k3-tp8-pp2-humming` |
| `--moe-backend` | `humming` | `humming` |
| Parallelism | TP8 × PP2 | TP8 × PP2 |
| GPUs | 16× H200 | 16× H200 |
| `--gpu-memory-utilization` | `0.90` | `0.90` |
| `--max-num-seqs` | `256` | `256` |
| `--max-model-len` | `8192` | `8192` |
| Image | `vllm/vllm-openai:kimi-k3` | `vllm/vllm-openai:kimi-k3` |
| Harness | `vllm bench serve` (`/v1/completions`) | GuideLLM concurrent (`/v1/chat/completions`) |
| Stop condition | `num_prompts` ≈ 2 min / tier | `max_duration` **600 s / stream** |
| Seed | `{python} SEED_OLD` | n/a (GuideLLM synthetic) |
| PipelineRun | n/a | `kimi-k3-tp8-pp2-humming-1k-1k-cf8e6b` |
| MLflow | n/a | [experiment 372 / `6b4f197e…`](`{python} MLFLOW_URL`) |
| Data | [`conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000) | MLflow artifact `results/benchmark_output.json` (pulled at render time) |

# How to read the comparison

These are **not** identical benchmarks:

- **vLLM-bench** sends a fixed prompt count and **waits for every request to finish**. C=1 used 7 prompts (~127 s); C=512 used 1024 prompts (~269 s). `output_throughput` is completed output tokens / wall time.
- **GuideLLM** holds each concurrency for **600 s** and then stops. Requests still in flight are `incomplete` (0 at C=1, **509 at C=512**). Decode throughput below is GuideLLM `output_tokens_per_second.total.mean` (all requests, matches the BenchFlow console “All Requests” table).
- **ITL, not GuideLLM TPOT.** vLLM-bench `mean_tpot_ms` is inter-token time after the first token. GuideLLM `time_per_output_token_ms` is closer to E2E / output tokens (includes TTFT). The plots compare **mean ITL** (`mean_itl_ms` vs `inter_token_latency_ms`).

C=1 is the cleanest apples-to-apples check (no in-flight cutoff). High-C gaps mix serving behavior with harness cutoff.

```{python}
#| label: headline
#| output: asis
c1_thr = merged.loc[merged["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
peak_gap = peak_new["output_throughput"] / peak_old["output_throughput"]
print(
    f"- **C=1 decode:** archived {base_old['output_throughput']:.1f} tok/s vs "
    f"MLflow {base_new['output_throughput']:.1f} tok/s "
    f"({c1_thr['pct_output_throughput']:+.1f}%)\n"
    f"- **C=1 TTFT / ITL:** archived {base_old['mean_ttft_ms']:.0f} ms / "
    f"{base_old['mean_itl_ms']:.1f} ms vs MLflow {base_new['mean_ttft_ms']:.0f} ms / "
    f"{base_new['mean_itl_ms']:.1f} ms\n"
    f"- **Peak decode:** archived {peak_old['output_throughput']:.0f} tok/s @ C="
    f"{int(peak_old['concurrency'])} vs MLflow {peak_new['output_throughput']:.0f} tok/s @ C="
    f"{int(peak_new['concurrency'])} ({peak_gap:.3f}×)\n"
    f"- **C=256 (largest tok/s gap):** archived "
    f"{merged.loc[merged['concurrency']==256,'output_throughput_old'].iloc[0]:.0f} vs "
    f"MLflow {merged.loc[merged['concurrency']==256,'output_throughput_new'].iloc[0]:.0f} "
    f"({merged.loc[merged['concurrency']==256,'pct_output_throughput'].iloc[0]:+.1f}%)"
)
```

# Comparison charts

## Decode throughput

```{python}
#| label: fig-tok
#| fig-cap: "Output token throughput vs concurrency. Archived = vLLM-bench output_throughput; MLflow = GuideLLM output_tokens_per_second.total.mean."

fig = px.line(
    both,
    x="concurrency",
    y="output_throughput",
    color="run",
    color_discrete_map=RUN_COLORS,
    markers=True,
    labels={
        "concurrency": "max concurrency",
        "output_throughput": "out tok/s",
        "run": "",
    },
)
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02), margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

## Latency

```{python}
#| label: fig-latency
#| fig-cap: "Mean TTFT (left) and mean ITL (right). ITL is the comparable decode-time metric; GuideLLM TPOT is omitted (different definition)."

fig = make_subplots(rows=1, cols=2, subplot_titles=("TTFT (ms)", "ITL (ms)"))
for run, dfx in [(LABEL_OLD, df_old), (LABEL_NEW, df_new)]:
    color = RUN_COLORS[run]
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=dfx["concurrency"],
            y=dfx["mean_ttft_ms"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=run,
            legendgroup=run,
            line=dict(color=color),
            showlegend=True,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=1,
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=dfx["concurrency"],
            y=dfx["mean_itl_ms"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=run,
            legendgroup=run,
            line=dict(color=color),
            showlegend=False,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=2,
    )
for col in (1, 2):
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=col)
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.08), margin=dict(t=50))
fig.show()
```

## Ratio (MLflow ÷ archived)

```{python}
#| label: fig-ratio
#| fig-cap: "BenchFlow/MLflow ÷ archived vLLM-bench. 1.0 = parity. Throughput below 1 means the new run is slower."

fig = make_subplots(
    rows=1,
    cols=3,
    subplot_titles=("tok/s", "TTFT", "ITL"),
)
metrics = [
    ("ratio_output_throughput", 1),
    ("ratio_mean_ttft_ms", 2),
    ("ratio_mean_itl_ms", 3),
]
for col, cidx in metrics:
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=merged["concurrency"],
            y=merged[col],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=col.replace("ratio_", ""),
            line=dict(color="#17becf"),
            showlegend=False,
        ),
        row=1,
        col=cidx,
    )
    fig.add_hline(y=1.0, line_dash="dot", line_color="#adb5bd", row=1, col=cidx)
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=cidx)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(t=50), height=420)
fig.show()
```

# Side-by-side numbers

Decode throughput is the column to compare first. Ratios are MLflow / archived.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-compare
#| tbl-cap: "Humming 1000/1000: archived vLLM-bench vs BenchFlow GuideLLM (MLflow)."
cmp = merged[
    [
        "concurrency",
        "output_throughput_old",
        "output_throughput_new",
        "pct_output_throughput",
        "mean_ttft_ms_old",
        "mean_ttft_ms_new",
        "mean_itl_ms_old",
        "mean_itl_ms_new",
        "incomplete_new",
    ]
].copy()
cmp["concurrency"] = cmp["concurrency"].astype(int)
cmp["incomplete_new"] = cmp["incomplete_new"].astype(int)
cmp = cmp.rename(
    columns={
        "concurrency": "C",
        "output_throughput_old": "tok/s archived",
        "output_throughput_new": "tok/s MLflow",
        "pct_output_throughput": "tok/s Δ%",
        "mean_ttft_ms_old": "TTFT arch",
        "mean_ttft_ms_new": "TTFT MLflow",
        "mean_itl_ms_old": "ITL arch",
        "mean_itl_ms_new": "ITL MLflow",
        "incomplete_new": "MLflow in-flight",
    }
)
cmp.style.hide(axis="index").format(
    {
        "C": "{:d}",
        "tok/s archived": "{:.1f}",
        "tok/s MLflow": "{:.1f}",
        "tok/s Δ%": "{:+.1f}",
        "TTFT arch": "{:.1f}",
        "TTFT MLflow": "{:.1f}",
        "ITL arch": "{:.1f}",
        "ITL MLflow": "{:.1f}",
        "MLflow in-flight": "{:d}",
    }
)
```
